root_cause_criterion.description: Before recording an open element on the SAX1 bookkeeping path, the parser must have a non-null parallel pushTab entry array for that open element because later premature-EOF handling reads ctxt->pushTab[ctxt->nameNr - 1].line.

nodes.description: The sink dereference executes with ctxt->pushTab still null.

edges.description: The incremented open-element count from namePush is the same count later used to index pushTab on the premature-EOF path.
The null pushTab state left after namePush is the same base pointer later dereferenced at the sink.
The CUR == 0 premature-EOF branch executes and immediately leads to the pushTab line read.
